proposal.expected_benefit: This change will reduce unnecessary audit overhead in simulation-only scenarios, improve the accuracy of the simulation's intent, and ensure that audit requirements are only enforced in contexts where they are truly needed.
proposal.problem: The critic's analysis highlights a contradiction between the 'audit-before-execution' mitigation and the simulation-only context, which may lead to unnecessary audit overhead or misinterpretation of the simulation's intent.
proposal.proposed_change: Update the strategy to explicitly differentiate between simulation-only scenarios and real-world execution contexts. In simulation-only scenarios, audit requirements should be dynamically adjusted or disabled to avoid unnecessary overhead, while ensuring that the simulation accurately reflects the intended control logic. This will prevent misinterpretation of the simulation's intent and ensure that audit requirements are only enforced where necessary.
proposal.title: Clarify Audit Context in Simulation-Only Scenarios
verification_tests: Validate that audit requirements are dynamically adjusted in simulation-only scenarios.
Ensure that the simulation accurately reflects the intended control logic without unnecessary overhead.
